words.meaning: literal: the small stump overturns the big cart; real: small forces can defeat bigger ones
words.example: Echipa mică a câștigat; buturuga mică răstoarnă carul mare.
words.exampleMeaning: The small team won; small forces can defeat bigger ones.

words.word: cine se scoală de dimineață departe ajunge
words.reading: chee-neh seh sko-ah-luh deh dee-mee-nyah-tsuh deh-par-teh ah-joon-jeh
words.meaning: literal: whoever gets up in the morning gets far; real: early effort brings success
words.example: Mă trezesc devreme, fiindcă cine se scoală de dimineață departe ajunge.
words.exampleMeaning: I wake up early because early effort brings success.

words.meaning: literal: water passes, stones remain; real: troubles pass, lasting things remain
words.example: După scandal, am zis că apa trece, pietrele rămân.
words.exampleMeaning: After the scandal, I said that troubles pass and lasting things remain.

words.meaning: literal: the mouth of the world; real: public gossip or what people will say
words.example: Nu te teme de gura lumii; fă ce e corect.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not fear public gossip; do what is right.

words.word: nu aduce anul ce aduce ceasul
words.reading: noo ah-doo-cheh ah-nool cheh ah-doo-cheh chah-sool
words.meaning: literal: the year does not bring what the hour brings; real: big changes can happen suddenly
words.example: Nu aduce anul ce aduce ceasul, așa că fii pregătit.
words.exampleMeaning: Big changes can happen suddenly, so be prepared.

words.meaning: literal: the person sanctifies the place; real: a good person improves any place
words.example: Noul director a renovat școala; omul sfințește locul.
words.exampleMeaning: The new principal renovated the school; a good person improves any place.

words.meaning: literal: haste spoils the work; real: rushing leads to mistakes
words.example: Verificăm încet, pentru că graba strică treaba.
words.exampleMeaning: We check slowly because rushing leads to mistakes.

words.meaning: literal: a lie has short legs; real: lies are discovered quickly
words.example: Adevărul a ieșit la iveală; minciuna are picioare scurte.
words.exampleMeaning: The truth came out; lies are discovered quickly.

words.meaning: literal: sweet speech brings much; real: kindness and tact help
words.example: Vorbește frumos, că vorba dulce mult aduce.
words.exampleMeaning: Speak nicely, because kindness and tact help.

words.meaning: literal: where there are many, strength grows; real: unity brings strength
words.example: Voluntarii au reușit împreună: unde-s mulți, puterea crește.
words.exampleMeaning: The volunteers succeeded together: unity brings strength.

words.word: la pomul lăudat să nu te duci cu sacul
words.reading: lah po-mool luh-oo-daht suh noo teh dooch koo sah-kool
words.meaning: literal: do not go to the praised tree with a sack; real: do not expect too much from hype
words.example: Filmul era prea lăudat; la pomul lăudat să nu te duci cu sacul.
words.exampleMeaning: The film was overpraised; do not expect too much from hype.

words.meaning: literal: what is in hand is not a lie; real: a sure thing is valuable
words.example: Accept oferta sigură; ce-i în mână nu-i minciună.
words.exampleMeaning: I accept the safe offer; a sure thing is valuable.

words.meaning: literal: according to the deed, so the reward; real: actions have consequences
words.example: A muncit mult și a primit premiul: după faptă și răsplată.
words.exampleMeaning: He worked hard and received the prize: actions have consequences.

words.word: nu lăsa pe mâine ce poți face azi
words.reading: noo luh-sah peh muh-ee-neh cheh potsee fah-cheh ahz
words.meaning: literal: do not leave for tomorrow what you can do today; real: do not postpone tasks
words.example: Termin tema acum: nu lăsa pe mâine ce poți face azi.
words.exampleMeaning: I finish the homework now: do not postpone tasks.

words.word: lupul își schimbă părul, dar năravul ba
words.reading: loo-pool uhsh skheem-buh puh-rool dar nuh-rah-vool bah
words.meaning: literal: the wolf changes its fur, but not its habit; real: character is hard to change
words.example: Nu te baza pe promisiunea lui; lupul își schimbă părul, dar năravul ba.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not rely on his promise; character is hard to change.

words.word: dar din dar se face rai
words.reading: dar deen dar seh fah-cheh rye
words.meaning: literal: gift from gift makes heaven; real: generosity creates goodness
words.example: Am donat și noi, fiindcă dar din dar se face rai.
